content: The OneTouch Ultra is a blood glucose monitoring device specifically designed for individuals with diabetes. It serves as the foundational product for LifeScan's OneTouch Ultra Family of blood glucose monitoring systems. The OneTouch Ultra Blood Glucose Meters are capable of delivering blood glucose test results within just 5 seconds. These devices also allow for testing at alternate sites on the body and come equipped with various memory and flagging features to enhance usability. Each OneTouch Meter is sold as part of a kit that includes a carrying case, a lancing device, a control solution, a sample quantity of lancets, and a replacement cap for the lancing device, which is used when performing alternate site testing. The OneTouch Ultra 2 model shares a similar design and operational functionality with the original OneTouch Ultra Meter. However, it includes additional features such as Before and After Meal Flags, the ability to add Comments, and a list-style memory recall. This meter also provides averages for 7-day, 14-day, and 30-day periods, with the option to calculate averages specifically for Before Meal or After Meal records. Other meters in the OneTouch Ultra series include the OneTouch UltraSmart and the OneTouch UltraMini Meter, which is marketed as the OneTouch UltraEasy in Europe. In addition to the original Silver Moon color, LifeScan introduced three new colors for the OneTouch UltraMini Meter in the summer of 2007: Pink Glow, Limelight, and Jet Black. Certain OneTouch Meters are equipped with data ports, allowing them to be used in conjunction with the downloadable OneTouch Diabetes Management Software and a personal computer. This software enables users to compute averages and identify trends in their blood glucose levels. The software can be obtained from LifeScan's official website, although an interface cable must be purchased separately to connect the meter to a computer. Notable Advertising Campaigns The legendary blues musician B.B. King, who lived with diabetes for over 10 years, participated in an advertising campaign for the OneTouch Ultra. In the campaign, he described the emotional challenges of living with diabetes, using the metaphor of feeling blue. One of the commercials featured him alongside a younger individual with diabetes who also played blues music. The campaign emphasized the benefits of alternate site testing. Patti LaBelle, a renowned singer who has lived with diabetes for over 12 years, was featured in an advertising campaign for the OneTouch Ultra2. In the campaign, she recounted a personal story about collapsing on stage, which led to her diabetes diagnosis. For one of the commercials, she re-recorded her 1980s hit song New Attitude. OneTouch is also prominently associated with Inverness Caledonian Thistle, a professional football club in Scotland. The brand serves as the main shirt sponsor for the team, reflecting LifeScan's significant role as a major employer in the city of Inverness.
